title: hieracium jurassicum subsp. pseudalbinum
intro: Hieracium jurassicum subsp. pseudalbinum, commonly known as Alpine Hawkweed, is a plant species native to the European Alps. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that may help reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Hawkweed are attributed to its ability to stimulate the immune system, reduce pain and fever, and exhibit antimicrobial activity. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Hawkweed include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
